summary: Write a chunk with Node validation, buffering, callback timing, and the backpressure boolean return.

target.notes: Admit/validate the chunk, buffer as needed, invoke the per-write callback asynchronously after handling, and return false when buffered size reaches/exceeds highWaterMark.

semantics.callback_error: callback receives write error before corresponding error event

caveats: Do not ignore the return value; doing so defeats Node backpressure.
String decoding, TypedArray/DataView support, and objectMode affect accepted chunks.

tests.name: highWaterMark false
tests.input: const {Writable}=require('node:stream'); let done; const w=new Writable({highWaterMark:1,write(c,e,cb){done=cb}}); console.log(w.write(Buffer.from([1]))); done();

tests.name: null rejected in object mode
tests.expected_behavior: throws a Node invalid-argument/type error; null is not a valid data item
